author: coder-sonnet
message: Implemented the INF-001 deliverable in full within src/gas/setup/** (only allowed path, roadmap.md not touched): schema.gs (PANEL_OPS_SCHEMA, 16 tabs with header arrays transcribed field-for-field from data-model.md, in listed order, no extra columns); seeds.gs (WORKFLOW_STATES_SEED = 17 rows transcribed from workflow-state-machine.md's state table; TRANSITION_MATRIX_SEED generated from that doc's Transition Matrix + Guards sections, keyed by from-state with roles/guard per allowed transition, plus lost_from_any_non_terminal and management_reopen per the doc's prose rules; SEQUENCES_SEED as an initial counter shape -- not specified elsewhere, flagged as an implementation choice for INF-002 to confirm/extend; CONFIGURATION_SEED covering all 8 keys named in the ticket with the exact literal values given (vat_rate=0.19, edge_waste_factor=1.10, quotation_validity_hours=48, aging_alert_minutes=60) plus transition_matrix/sequences/empty withholding_rules/empty company_legal_info; LOSS_REASONS_SEED as a generic Spanish starter list -- no canonical list exists anywhere in the repo, ticket explicitly calls for a 'starter list' so this is a placeholder, flagged for later replacement via the Loss_Reasons UI; USERS_SEED as 3 explicit non-functional placeholder emails (management/sales/billing) per the ticket's own wording 'Users placeholders'); setup.gs (setupPanelOpsWorkbook() -- idempotent: stores the created Spreadsheet ID in PropertiesService.getScriptProperties() so re-runs reopen the same workbook instead of creating a duplicate; per-tab header write only happens if the current header row differs from schema; per-tab seeding only happens if the tab has zero data rows, except Configuration which is upserted by key so user edits to existing keys are never overwritten; removes the default empty 'Sheet1' if still empty after setup); selfCheck.gs (runSelfCheck() reads back every tab's header row and diffs against PANEL_OPS_SCHEMA, plus checks Workflow_States row count, Configuration key presence, Loss_Reasons and Users row counts, logging PASS/FAIL per check via Logger.log, matching the ticket's specified verification approach exactly). BLOCKER: this executor's sandbox has no Google Workspace/clasp/OAuth credentials and no way to actually create/open a Google Sheets file or execute Apps Script code (verified: 'which clasp' -> not found; no ~/.clasprc.json reachable -- filesystem access is restricted to this project directory only; no network/OAuth flow available). The ticket's verification commands and 'run evidence' deliverable both require live execution against a real Drive/Sheets file, which is not possible here. I could not even run node --check on the .gs files -- that specific command was denied by the sandbox's Bash permission policy (multiple attempts, including bare node --check <file> and node -e ..., all returned 'This command requires approval' with no interactive approver in this session). As a partial substitute I manually re-verified: (1) every one of the 16 header arrays in schema.gs against data-model.md's table definitions, column-by-column, in order; (2) all 17 Workflow_States seed rows and the full transition matrix against workflow-state-machine.md; (3) brace/paren counts balanced per file (schema.gs 16/16, seeds.gs 31/31, setup.gs 29/29, selfCheck.gs 28/28) as a lightweight syntax sanity check. None of this substitutes for actually running setupPanelOpsWorkbook() + runSelfCheck() inside Apps Script and capturing the PASS/FAIL log, which is what the ticket requires as evidence. To unblock: a human (or an agent with Google account access / clasp login configured) needs to (a) create or open the target Apps Script project bound to a Google account, (b) push these 4 files (clasp push or paste into the Apps Script editor), (c) run setupPanelOpsWorkbook() once from the editor, (d) run runSelfCheck() and share the Logger.log output (or execution log) back into this ticket so it can be marked complete against the real acceptance criteria (self-check PASS on all 16 tabs, seeds present, re-run makes no changes).
